# Copilot instructions for tflspec

Before you do any work, read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) (the file `AGENTS.md`
at the repository root). Before you add a template, also read
[dev/adding-a-template.md](../dev/adding-a-template.md) (the file
`dev/adding-a-template.md`). Do not rely on links alone: open these files.

This repository is the R package tflspec (`DESCRIPTION` is at the root).

- Orientation, the rules to keep and the git steps: [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)
- Workflow, checks and pull requests: [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- Adding a template: [dev/adding-a-template.md](../dev/adding-a-template.md)

Branch from `main`, open the pull request against `main` (only the
maintainers use `next`), and leave `Version:` and `NEWS.md` alone. Fill the
"User-visible change (for NEWS)" field of the pull request template. One
change per pull request; do not stack pull requests. Use fictional data only.
R source is ASCII-only.
